name: money
description: The cash counter of the HUD: a metric as a dollar amount that counts up and down to every new value, with the last change fading out below it.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric shown as cash, e.g. the used memory in MB

config.name: multiplier
config.label: Multiplier
config.description: Multiplies the value before it is shown, to make small values look like real money

config.name: prefix
config.label: Currency Sign
config.description: The text in front of the amount

config.name: hide_change
config.label: Hide Change
config.description: Hides the change of the last update below the amount

config.name: align
config.label: Alignment
config.description: Where the amount sits in the widget

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font of the amount. Defaults to Pricedown if it is installed, Impact otherwise

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. If not set, it follows the size of the widget

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the amount. Defaults to cash green
